content: Obesity is a risk factor for the development of several cancers, including breast, colon, and gynecologic carcinomas1, 2. Recently, it has been established that obesity not only correlates with carcinogenesis but also influences the prognosis of various cancer patients. For example, obesity has been associated with poor prognosis in breast3, 4 and colon cancers5, 6, while favorable prognoses have been reported in obese patients with gastric7 or renal8 cancers.
